sampling: one JVM per five-query cohort, all tries adjacent per query; same original 55C cooldown and 50W cap; full envelope unchanged
metrics: historical C6A projection using only tries2,3 for the five-query subset (not a full score)
internal median of final half of tries2..k to screen warmup drift
scope: steering-only selected-query stability experiment; never rank or claim full-suite resolution
stopping: fixed20 independent JVMs, no extension based on score; stop on execution/power/ownership failure or Firstmate steer
interpretation: Post-hoc per-k stability curves are descriptive; selecting k needs an independent full-context validation. Query covariance shares overlap; do not add 45.6% and46.1%.
